title: Google launches "Stitch Loop": an AI agent that keeps fixing your app after launch, non-stop! 🔧
body: Google launches "Stitch Loop": an AI agent that keeps fixing your app after launch, non-stop! 🔧

Google announced yesterday "Stitch Loop", an AI agent that connects to your app's code and live metrics — logs, user behavior, and feedback — and keeps improving the app around the clock after launch. The agent works in three integrated loops: cybersecurity, speed, and accessibility, plus custom loops such as sales optimization.

Imagine a mechanic who never leaves the workshop: it watches your app, spots what is slow or broken, writes the fix in an isolated environment, and opens a pull request on GitHub for a human to review. No change is merged until a human approves it. Google has opened a global waitlist, with priority for subscribers to its top-tier plan, and has not yet announced pricing or a date for wider availability.
Would you let an AI agent watch your app and suggest fixes? 🤖
